label: bosses
description: 3 large boss creatures, 4 animation frames each
original_prompt: Now generate a sprite sheet of 3 huge retro arcade BOSS sprites for the SAME game, continuing the exact same AQUATIC / deep-sea alien theme and pixel-art style as the enemy sheet above (same neon palette, same black background, same crisp 16-bit look). These are large menacing final-boss creatures, bigger and more detailed than the regular enemies. LAYOUT: 3 rows x 4 columns on a solid pure black background. Each row is one unique boss; the 4 columns in that row are its 4 animation frames shown left-to-right. All cells exactly the same size (512x512 px), evenly spaced, no text, no labels, no borders between cells. Image 2048 wide x 1536 tall. STYLE: identical to the enemy sheet - crisp 16-bit neo-arcade pixel art, underwater bioluminescent neon colors (cyan, teal, magenta, poison-green, orange, red) glowing against dark abyss-black. Sharp hard edges, NO anti-aliasing, NO gradients, flat shading with highlight + shadow steps, high contrast, symmetrical, front-facing, no perspective. Glowing accent eyes/cores. 1px dark rim outline. Large intimidating bosses filling most of each cell. ROWS (top to bottom), 4 distinct loopable frames each: 1. GIANT EVIL OCTOPUS - massive purple/magenta octopus with many long writhing tentacles, huge glowing red eyes, menacing open maw with teeth. Frames: tentacle spread cycle (wide -> mid -> tight -> mid). 2. MEGALODON LEVIATHAN SHARK - colossal armored cyan/teal mega-shark with metallic plating, glowing green eyes, rows of huge teeth, dorsal fin. Frames: jaw open/close + fin flick cycle (closed -> opening -> wide open -> closing). 3. ABYSSAL KRAKEN DREADNOUGHT - enormous dark teal kraken with thick armored tentacles, multiple glowing orange eyes, crown of spikes, central glowing core. Frames: tentacle wave + core glow pulse cycle (phase 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4). Frames within each row must be clearly distinct but smoothly sequential (loopable). Keep it clean and croppable, consistent scale so all three read as same-tier bosses matching the enemy sheet style.
